Initial release of Video Filter Effects — Apply Filters and Export Videos.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM (up to 500MB) and apply AI-powered video filters via cloud rendering.
- Describe effects (cinematic color grade, vintage film grain, etc.) and receive processed clips in 20–40 seconds.
- Easily export 1080p MP4 files suitable for social media.
- Automated onboarding and setup with free trial (100 credits, 7-day expiry).
- Includes error handling, session management, and support for batch/iterative workflows.
